outcome: The CRM slot: the one connector the CRM-dependent cookbooks read from and write back to

inputs.ask: Which CRM holds your accounts and contacts?
inputs.why: The downstream contract is only the two models in base-gtm, so swapping this is a one-line change. Getting it wrong means every dependent cookbook writes into a system nobody reads.
inputs.derive: cargo-ai connection list: if exactly one of hubspot / salesforce / attio is already authenticated in this workspace, that is the answer
inputs.validate: the chosen integration appears in the connector catalog and is authenticated

inputs.ask: Set the CRM credential in .env before deploy (HUBSPOT_API_KEY for a HubSpot private app)
inputs.why: secret() reads it at deploy time and keeps it out of the content hash, so rotating the token does not read as drift. Deploy fails without it.
inputs.validate: the variable is non-empty in the deploying environment; never print or store its value

doneWhen: the CRM connector shows as authenticated in the workspace
a dependent cookbook's write-back lands on a real CRM record

cost.note: The connector itself is free. Reads and writes through it are billed by the dependent cookbook, not here.

invariants.holds: The downstream contract is only the two models in base-gtm
invariants.whatBreaks: If a dependent cookbook reads CRM-shaped fields directly instead of going through `accounts`/`contacts`, swapping the CRM stops being a one-line change and every dependent breaks at once.

invariants.holds: The credential is read with secret(), never inlined
invariants.whatBreaks: An inlined token enters the content hash, so rotating it reads as drift, and it lands in git.

variations.when: Your accounts live in Salesforce or Attio rather than HubSpot
variations.how: Change the integration in `connectors/hubspot.ts` and set the matching credential; nothing downstream changes
variations.trade: None structurally. Action slugs and field names differ per provider, so any write-back column names need rechecking

variations.when: Your accounts and contacts already live in the CRM and should be sourced from it rather than filled by a sourcing cookbook
variations.how: Swap base-gtm's native models for connector-backed ones; the shape is written out at the top of base-gtm/models/accounts.ts
variations.trade: base-gtm stops deploying zero-config: a fresh workspace now needs the CRM credential before anything runs
